metric_definitions.mapq: Mobility, Arm & Precision Quotient: a reliability-adjusted 0-100 geometric blend of passing capability and movement capability.
metric_definitions.defense_stress_index: Defense Stress Index: a reliability-adjusted blend of deep-ball production, scramble threat, rushing frequency, and explosive-play rate.
metric_definitions.drive_extension_index: Drive Extension Index: a 0-100 blend of third-down conversions, touchdowns, and sack avoidance.
metric_definitions.escape_to_explosive_rate_proxy: Escape-to-Explosive Rate proxy: the share of estimated long-yardage escape opportunities that become a first down, touchdown, or 15-plus-yard QB rush.
